headline: Abidjan Metro: Keolis Côte d'Ivoire Launches Pre-Operation Phase of Line 1
summary: Keolis Côte d'Ivoire launched pre-operation activities for the future Abidjan metro line 1 on 20 November. The state has entrusted the firm with operating and maintaining the line.
why: Keolis is a French urban transport operator that runs public transit networks worldwide under concession contracts.
original_headline: Métro d’Abidjan : Keolis Côte d’Ivoire lance la phase de pré-exploitation de la ligne 1
